title: Naver IMAP App Password via CDP (2FA + IMAP enable)
desc: Automate Naver 2FA setup, app password generation, and IMAP activation using wkappbot CDP. Documents all pitfalls from real automation run.
steps: Open Naver security page: wkappbot cdp open https://nid.naver.com/user2/help/myInfoV2?m=viewSecurity --port 9222 --no-launch. Resize window to 900px+ height (Win32 MoveWindow) so below-fold buttons (Next, Generate) become visible.
CDP WebSocket MUST use suppress_origin=True -- plain Origin header returns 403 Forbidden. Pattern: websocket.create_connection(ws_url, timeout=10, suppress_origin=True)
Dismiss pending JS alert() BEFORE connecting WebSocket: an open alert blocks ALL CDP recv() calls forever. Use Add-Type Win32 + SetForegroundWindow + System.Windows.Forms SendKeys Enter to dismiss.

Suppress future alerts before calling page JS: window.alert=function(m){console.log(m)}. Then call createAppPswd(). App name max 10 chars. Result appears in DOM field id=appPasswd (12-char alphanumeric).

React inputs ignore .value= -- use nativeInputValueSetter: var s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; s.call(inp,'mail'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))

IMAP radio needs physical focusless click not CDP setter (React state not updated by DOM). Get screen coords: CDP getBoundingClientRect + window ltwh from a11y find. Use wkappbot a11y click '{hwnd:0xXXXX}#*' --x cx_rel --y cy_rel (win-click is DEPRECATED as of v5.x 2026-05-02; it now only emits a paste-ready a11y click suggestion and exits 1). Then CDP button.click() to save.
Store result in D:\GitHub\.env as NAVER_APP_PASSWORD; scripts use _load_central_env() fallback.
